parameters.query:
SELECT
    $11::jsonb AS input_context,
    prepare_wf05_provision_client(
        $1::uuid,
        $2::uuid,
        $3::text,
        $4::uuid,
        $5::uuid,
        $6::uuid,
        $7::text,
        $8::text,
        $9::integer,
        $10::integer
    ) AS preparation_result;

parameters.jsCode:
// Build the canonical WF99 explicit-internal error envelope
// when WF05 cannot safely prepare a provisioning operation.

const input = $json ?? {};

if (
  input.next_action !==
  'operator_intervention_required'
) {
  throw new Error(
    'Build WF05 Preparation Intervention Context received an invalid next action',
  );
}

const executionId =
  String($execution.id ?? '').trim() ||
  null;

return {
  json: {
    source_variant:
      'explicit_internal',

    source_workflow_name:
      'WF05 - Provision Client',

    source_workflow_id:
      '1nU3HodQoHZJPuHX',

    source_execution_id:
      executionId,

    case_id:
      input.case_id ?? null,

    correlation_id:
      input.correlation_id ?? null,

    step_id:
      input.provision_step_id ?? null,

    submission_id:
      input.accepted_submission_id ?? null,

    external_operation_id:
      input.operation_id ??
      input.external_operation_id ??
      null,

    error_class:
      input.preparation_outcome ===
      'failed_terminal'
        ? 'provider_terminal_failure'
        : 'workflow_contract_failure',

    error_code:
      input.error_code ??
      'wf05_provisioning_preparation_failed',

    error_message:
      'WF05 could not safely prepare the client provisioning operation.',

    retryable:
      false,

    severity:
      'error',

    requires_intervention:
      true,

    error_details: {
      preparation_outcome:
        input.preparation_outcome ?? null,

      operation_claim_outcome:
        input.operation_claim_outcome ?? null,

      operation_status:
        input.operation_status ?? null,

      operation_attempt_count:
        input.operation_attempt_count ?? null,

      operation_max_attempts:
        input.operation_max_attempts ?? null,

      case_state:
        input.case_state ?? null,

      provision_step_status:
        input.provision_step_status ?? null,

      trigger_source:
        input.trigger_source ?? null,
    },
  },
};
